# test-plan/ — generated by the Ejara Automation Tool

One JSON file per module of the Payment Panel test plan (TC IDs, titles, labels and their tags, priority, platforms,
environments, automation status, former IDs, case version). **Never edit these files by hand**: change the case in
the tool, download the plan bundle (App page › Automation) and run `npm run plan:apply -- <bundle.json> --write`.

Until then, each test carries its former ID at the start of its title (`PP-AUTH-01 …`), which the tool's cases keep
in Legacy IDs: run results link to the cases right away. `plan:apply` renames them to the tool's TC IDs.
